description: This file implements functions for data validation and sanitization according to a specified data schema, particularly related to VSS (Vehicle Signal Specification). It includes type checking, range validation, and enum validation for different data types, as well as templates for numeric types.

classes.name: VssDatabase
classes.description: Class providing data validation and sanitization methods for VSS data types.

methods.name: void checkNumTypes(jsoncons::json & meta,jsoncons::json & val)
methods.description: Templated function to check if a numeric JSON value can be converted to a specific type, and within bounds, considering infinity and min/max constraints.

methods.name: void checkBoolType(jsoncons::json & val)
methods.description: Function to validate and convert a JSON value to a boolean, accepting string representations 'true' or 'false'.

methods.name: void checkEnumType(jsoncons::json & enumDefinition,jsoncons::json & val)
methods.description: Function to validate that a JSON value matches one of the allowed enum string values.

methods.name: VssDatabase::checkArrayType
methods.description: Method to check if an array JSON value conforms to the specified subdatatype by applying recursive validation.

methods.name: VssDatabase::checkAndSanitizeType
methods.description: Core method to validate and sanitize a JSON value against metadata specifying its datatype, including support for numeric types, boolean, string, enum, and arrays.
